name: Collection/Exfil - Local Data Collection from Test Directories (T1005)
blast_radius: Searches a designated test directory for files matching a synthetic bas_sim_* pattern; counts matches only. Never reads contents of any file it did not create itself.

name: Collection/Exfil - Network Share Collection (T1039)
blast_radius: Read-only listing of a share on a designated lab target ($env:BAS_TEST_HOST); SKIP when unset. Never downloads or modifies share contents.

name: Collection/Exfil - Email Collection Simulation (T1114.001)
blast_radius: Checks only for local mail-client presence (process or profile-registry-key existence). Never opens a mailbox or reads real email content.
telemetry: Process / registry presence check for mail clients

name: Collection/Exfil - Archive Collected Data (T1560.001)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic test file, archives it with Compress-Archive, verifies the archive, then deletes both file and archive in the same step (self-cleaning).
detection: EDR: archive-creation prior to exfiltration pattern

name: Collection/Exfil - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel Simulation (T1041)
blast_radius: Posts one small synthetic payload to the lab bfsisim exfil-sink endpoint only. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable; never reaches a real C2 channel or external host.
telemetry: HTTP POST to lab-local exfil sink

name: Collection/Exfil - DNS Exfiltration Simulation (T1048.003)
blast_radius: Resolves one synthetic subdomain under the RFC 6761 .invalid TLD, which never resolves. Successful resolution (should never happen) is FAIL; resolution failure is PASS.
telemetry: DNS query for a synthetic bas-sim-*.invalid subdomain
detection: DNS logging: anomalous subdomain query patterns
